tasks.prompt: 写 JavaScript 函数 parseCents(value)。value 必须是字符串：允许两端空白；只接受非负十进制金额，整数部分至少一位，小数最多两位；拒绝指数写法、符号、千分位、Infinity、空串、超过两位小数。返回整数分数，超过 Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER 则返回 null。非法类型或格式返回 null。不能把非法值四舍五入成合法值。只输出函数代码，不要 Markdown 或解释。

tasks.title: 区间合并：乱序、相邻区间与输入不可变
tasks.titleEn: Interval merging, touching intervals and immutability
tasks.prompt: 写 JavaScript 函数 mergeIntervals(intervals)。输入为有限数字组成的闭区间 [start,end] 数组，保证 start<=end，输入可能乱序。返回按 start 排序的合并闭区间，相接区间也合并；不要修改输入或任何内层数组，空数组返回空数组。只输出函数代码，不要 Markdown 或解释。

methodZh: 本轮通过 Kimi Coding Plan 原生 Anthropic Messages 协议调用 k3.1-pro，地址 https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/messages。每组计划 23 题，default / low / max 三组请求参数最多并发 3 个请求；每组内逐题执行。5 小时订阅额度耗尽后停止新请求，未派发任务不伪造记录，额度错误不计为模型答题失败。默认 effort 的文档值为 max；这两组保留独立请求，不当作两个不同能力档位。low / max 使用原生 output_config.effort；不把 thinking 预算当成 effort。输入 token 合计为原生 input_tokens、cache_read_input_tokens 与 cache_creation_input_tokens 之和，原 usage 字段完整保留。初轮 max_tokens=12,288，包含思考和正文；超时 600 秒，temperature / top_p 省略，没有独立设置 thinking.budget_tokens。按订阅额度消耗，不能按官方按量标价换算成实际账单。此前停止的 Chat Completions 子集单独保留。静态与动图源自模型原始 SVG，未修复源码；点评是 AI 助手的定性视觉检查。单次耗时受服务端排队、三个请求的并发和输出长度影响，不能据此建立稳定速度排名。逐次保留请求与返回模型 ID；可变 API 路由不构成内部固定 checkpoint 的独立证明。
methodEn: This batch calls k3.1-pro through Kimi Coding Plan’s native Anthropic Messages endpoint https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/messages. Each requested default/low/max configuration plans 23 tasks; at most three requests run concurrently, sequentially within each configuration. New dispatches stopped when the five-hour subscription quota was exhausted. Unsent tasks have no fabricated attempt, and quota failures are not scored as model-answer failures. Default is documented as max; omitted-default and explicit-max requests are independent records and are not treated as distinct capability levels. Low/max use native output_config.effort, not a thinking budget. Prompt-token totals sum native input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens; raw usage is retained. Initial max_tokens=12,288 covers thinking plus final output; timeout 600 seconds. Temperature/top_p omitted; no thinking.budget_tokens configured. Requests consume subscription quota; metered list prices are not the actual invoice. The stopped Chat Completions subset stays separate. Images and animation directly render the model’s unchanged SVG. Assessments are qualitative AI-assistant visual inspection. Single-request timings include queueing, concurrency and output-length effects; they do not establish a stable speed ranking. Requested and returned IDs are preserved; a mutable API route is not independent proof of a fixed internal checkpoint.
